name: JUSTTECH - RSS Source Into Webhook (example inbound push)

nodes.name: Fetch RSS (replace URL)
nodes.notes: MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED: point this at a real RSS feed URL. This is a demonstration of pushing opportunities INTO JUSTTECH from a source n8n can reach that the backend's own RSS ingestor doesn't already cover.

nodes.name: POST To JUSTTECH
nodes.notes: MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED: set the JUSTTECH_N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable inside n8n to the same value as the backend's N8N_WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET. Update the URL if the backend isn't running on localhost:8000.
